name: decimal-consumption-effects
expression: (do (def invalid-context-effects (atom [])) (let [result (binding [*math-context* :invalid] (try (eval '(do (swap! invalid-context-effects conj :before) (/ 1M 3M) (swap! invalid-context-effects conj :after))) (catch Throwable e :error)))] [result @invalid-context-effects]))

name: unused-lazy-value
expression: (let [effects (atom 0) context (lazy-seq (swap! effects inc) (list :invalid))] (binding [*math-context* context] [(try (eval '(+ 1 2)) (catch Throwable e :error)) @effects]))

name: raw-macro-opaque-context-consumption
expression: (let [v (eval '(defmacro invalid-context-opaque-decimal [] (let [effects (atom []) result (try (do (swap! effects conj :before) (/ 1M 3M) (swap! effects conj :after)) (catch Throwable e :error))] [result @effects])))] (binding [*math-context* (fn [] :invalid)] (try (v nil nil) (catch Throwable e :error))))

name: unused-lazy-macro-context
expression: (do (eval '(defmacro invalid-context-safe [] (list 'quote :safe))) (let [effects (atom 0) context (lazy-seq (swap! effects inc) (list :invalid))] (binding [*math-context* context] [(try (eval '(invalid-context-safe)) (catch Throwable e :error)) @effects])))

name: lazy-context-remains-unrealized-through-override
expression: (let [v (eval '(defmacro context-override-lazy [] (with-precision 3 (/ 1M 3M)))) effects (atom 0) context (lazy-seq (swap! effects inc) (list :invalid))] (binding [*math-context* context] [(try (v nil nil) (catch Throwable e :error)) @effects]))

name: nested-nil-binding-preserves-own-exception
expression: (let [v (eval '(defmacro context-override-error [] (binding [*math-context* nil] (throw (ex-info "inside override" {:inside true})))))] (binding [*math-context* (fn [] :invalid)] (try (v nil nil) (catch Throwable e (ex-data e)))))
